page.overview:
Who is Bamboo Minister?

He is a of the Land of Bamboo. He is also the former guardian of Kae Yukiwari's stepbrother.

The minister had been gathering fifty orphaned children and trained them to become his personal assassins. After many of them died, Hana Kaka was the one of the survivors and selected as his assassin. Ten years after the Fourth Shinobi World War, he ordered her to infiltrate Konoha and become an Academy teacher.

The minister is a scheming man who wishes Kae's younger stepbrother to ascend the throne instead of her, even willing to have her assassinated to ensure it. He is also cruel and ruthless as he had many orphans raised into his personal army of assassins, not caring if most of them died during the training.

The minister is a bald man with a dark short beard and two gold teeth.
